reference: Russell, A.J., & Street, K.N. (1982). Factors affecting the interlaminar fracture energy of graphite/epoxy laminates. Proceedings of the 4th International Conference on Composite Materials (ICCM-IV), Tokyo, Japan, pp. 279-286.
data_source: Tables I and II (tabulated), read from the page images of the scanned PDF on Zenodo (record 15403101, CC-BY-SA-4.0); the OCR layer garbles Table I

notes: Hercules AS1/3501-6 unidirectional, 24 plies for both groups, post-cured 8 h at 177 C, tested at 20 C dry, from Teflon-coated fabric strip starters. Table I (J/m2): G_IC at initiation 126 (24 plies) and 132 (24 plies, 2.1 % voids); the stabilized value G^s_IC, once a tied zone of bridged fibres has formed, 218 +- 3 and 218 (the +- is the standard error of the mean). Table II (J/m2): G_IIC at initiation from the Teflon notch 452 +- 6 and 504 +- 16 (voided); the re-initiation value G'_IIC after about 25 mm of extension, 385 +- 6, was not measured on the voided panel. One voided group only; the void measurement method and the baseline void content are not stated; the number of specimens is not given in the tables.
